title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2610.30017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice. The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols. translated_title: GuideEvolve：结合专家指导与3Ts机制的自进化智能体框架
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了GuideEvolve，这是一个融合专家指导与三种自主调节机制（统称为3Ts：快慢思考、时间回溯和自主选择终止）的自进化智能体框架。该框架通过双重创新解决了现有自进化智能体范式的关键局限性：（1）由任务特定专家评估驱动的进化流程；（2）集成3Ts机制，以促进认知优化、通过时间回溯实现性能恢复以及自适应终止协议。在MGSM和MMLU基准上的实证验证表明，GuideEvolve达到了与当前最先进模型相当的性能（在MGSM上准确率为89.8%，而Gödel Agent为90.6%；在MMLU上为89.1%，而Gödel Agent为87.9%），同时方差显著降低（25-59%），鲁棒性明显增强。此外，该框架还实现了100%的进化成功率。
tldr: GuideEvolve是一个结合专家指导与3Ts自主调节机制（快慢思考、时间回溯、自主终止）的自进化智能体框架，在MGSM和MMLU基准上达到与最先进模型相当的性能，同时显著降低方差、增强鲁棒性并实现100%的进化成功率。
en_tdlr: GuideEvolve is a self-evolving agent framework that combines expert guidance with 3Ts autonomous regulatory mechanisms (Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice), achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art models on MGSM and MMLU benchmarks while significantly reducing variance, enhancing robustness, and attaining a 100% evolution success rate.
